settings.title: Every tier is optional.
settings.intro: Emulsion is a complete editor with none of these. Each tier you add makes it better, and anything that needs a missing tier falls back or stays hidden.
settings.language_body: The language of menus, Home and Settings. Other screens are being translated and show English until then.
settings.layout_reuse_body: May reduce CPU use by reusing unchanged layout. Performance varies by workload; turn it off if rendering looks wrong or feels slower. Applies immediately to all windows. Your choice is saved.
settings.layout_reuse_override: A launch override will set the starting value again after restart.
settings.tier_builtin_body: Nodes, masks, blend modes, adjustments, OpenRaster and image formats, the offline request planner behind F1, and suggestions from image statistics.
settings.tier_models_body: Segmentation, subject mattes, depth, fill and upscaling that run on this machine with ONNX Runtime. Install what you want; each task's tools appear once its model is here. Select Subject and Remove Background need a matte model, the AI quick select needs SlimSAM.
settings.tier_cli_body: Multi-step requests from F1 go to a coding CLI that can only use Emulsion's tools. Every change it proposes is shown as an Apply / Skip card unless you turn on auto-apply. Claude Code asks before each tool; Codex, OpenCode and Kimi run one process per request and Emulsion holds their changes for you instead.

settings.next_session: The model picks up these settings the next time a document starts an assistant session.
settings.tier_jev_body: TypeSafe's Jev answers small typed questions with calibrated confidence. With a key, F1 requests are planned by Jev, which copes with looser phrasing than the offline planner, and only text leaves the machine: the request and layer names, never pixels.
settings.tier_shortcuts_body: Every shortcut, as it works right now. To change one, open the keymap file, uncomment a line and set its keys, then reload. Bare letters work while the canvas has focus; modifier shortcuts work anywhere.
settings.tier_image_body: Press F1 to choose Assistant, Local SD, OpenAI, or Google. Image modes create a new layer, or fill the selected area. The Select tool uses the default provider below.

about.intro: A non-destructive image editor with layers, masks, adjustment layers and a history you can branch. Brushes behave like their medium, recipes recreate film and camera looks, and camera RAW and Photoshop files open directly. Every AI feature is optional and runs on your machine unless you point it at a server of your own.
about.licence_body: Emulsion's own code is released under the MIT licence. The third-party code below keeps its own licences; nothing here relicenses it.
about.gpui_body: The user interface runs on GPUI, the GPU-accelerated UI framework from Zed Industries, through the gpui-kit component library by Longbridge. Emulsion ships its own copy of these packages, copied from their published releases and patched in a few files for software rendering and graphics-device recovery. Every change is marked in the file it touches and listed below, as the Apache licence requires.
about.models: AI models (downloaded only when you ask)
about.models_body: Each model keeps its author's licence. Read the terms before using a model's output commercially; the non-commercial ones say so here.
about.data_picture_note: A portrait in red and blue ink and water, generated for this project with OpenAI's image model and embedded as a JPEG.
about.data_lensfun_note: Lens distortion and vignetting profiles, fetched from the lensfun project when you install them in Settings.
about.data_recipes_note: Written for this project. Recipes you import from the web stay their authors' work and live only in your library.
about.copyleft: Weak-copyleft dependencies: %{list}. Their source is unmodified and available from their repositories; the release packages carry their licence texts.
